0000.png.text: A funnel chart can tell you where users drop off, but not why. Here, more than half of the checkouts that reach shipping never get to payment.

0001.png.text: Devin can close that loop. It reads the funnel, finds the step that loses people, watches the replays from that step, forms a hypothesis, and ships a fix behind a flag.
